biocontainers.name: nanosv
biocontainers.summary: Structural variation detection tool for oxford nanopore data.

biotools.summary: NanoSV is a software package that can be used to identify structural genomic variations in long-read sequencing data, such as data produced by Oxford Nanopore Technologies’ MinION, GridION or PromethION instruments, or Pacific Biosciences RSII or Sequel sequencers.
